chunks: (And say:) "O you who do not believe, make no excuses today. You will be requited only for what you had done."
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about excuses on the Day of Judgment for disbelievers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a direct rebuke to those who claim faith but fail to implement it, particularly highlighting the hypocrisy of the Banu Umayya or the Ahl al-Bayt's contemporaries who sought excuses for their spiritual negligence. It underscores the principle of 'Adl (Divine Justice), where recompense is not merely punitive but a precise reflection of one's actual deeds, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the unity of belief and action.
